Sofia (People Ops): Aya's visa stamp expired while renewal is in progress. Passport pages present, but latest visa page pending consulate. We need a short plan so Day-1 onboarding isn't blocked.

Ben (HR): For visa timing we can provision provisional access with recorded video + renewal receipt, or accept embassy-stamped appointment confirmation + recorded video. Benefits and laptop remain on a hold until we get a certified copy.

Aya (New Hire): I can show passport + appointment confirmation tonight on Zoom and upload the receipt. I prefer to start Monday if possible.

Sofia (People Ops): OK: 1) Aya does 5-min recorded Zoom showing passport and appointment + reads attestation, 2) HR files exception tag `visa-renewal-provisional`, 3) Payroll marks benefits pending, 4) IT provisions cloud-only access, holds physical device for 72 hrs.

Logan (IT): Confirmed. Will create email and Slack today, block VPN and badge, and queue laptop shipment with "hold for verification". DM Aya MFA steps.

Payroll-Bot: Note: benefits enrollment will be set to "pending-docs" and retro-activated if verified within 14 days. Reminder: enter SSN without dashes.

Aya (New Hire): Booked Zoom at 6pm local and uploaded appointment confirmation to secure intake link. Will read the script you provide.

Ben (HR): Attestation script: "I, [Full Name], confirm the passport and embassy appointment confirmation shown are mine. I consent to Redwood Inference storing this recording for onboarding verification."

Sofia (People Ops): Great — plan in motion. I'll log the exception in the Onboard Exceptions sheet and update the BG case after the recording. Will post back when HR signs off so IT can release the laptop. :white_check_mark:
